additional_info.subject: ID0402339-DC/Si-D/DE[170001890] - Outlet 2 unavailability CRM:00315002286
additional_info.body:
Hello Eduard, good morning.
From my investigation it seems there was a miscommunication in the SECC which caused the outlet to go unavailable. Now it's back online and must be working.
I will send this information to the regional colleagues and they will monitor the charging station in case it happens again. If you need any support on this topic please keep the discussion with this ticket number.
Thank you very much and have a nice week.
Best regards,
Francisco
